title: Reward Claim Backlog
dataSources: Habit activity (`lifeos:habit`), streaks (`lifeos:streak`), Beeminder goals (`lifeos:beeminder`), OKRs (`lifeos:okr`), planning syncs (`lifeos:ops`).
app: Personal life-OS telemetry — Habitica quest logs, Streaks app habit chains, Beeminder goal data, and personal OKR reviews — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lifeos:habit reward_type=* reward_claimed=*
| stats sum(eval(if(reward_claimed="no",1,0))) as backlog, count as total by reward_type
| where backlog>0
| sort - backlog
description: Lists pending unclaimed rewards backlog by reward type for gamified rewards.
value: Backlog counts expose where small unfinished tasks accumulate and create hidden drag inside gamified rewards.
implementation: Mark each `lifeos:habit` record with a pending-state flag and summarize backlog totals by `reward_type`.
visualization: Table of reward type with pending unclaimed rewards counts.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges where unfinished unclaimed rewards are piling up so you can clear the biggest queues in gamified rewards.
